topic: The mystery of the missing socks: detective Mishi discovers Bruno has been hiding them in his bed.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: The Missing Sock Mystery

shots.narration: One lonely sock remained—but where had all its friends gone?
shots.scene: Cosy colourful laundry nook, nearly empty wicker basket, warm sunlight, rounded 3D family animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi lifts one striped sock from the basket.
shots.mood: Curious green eyes, one raised eyebrow, bright playful colours.

shots.narration: Detective Mishi searched for a clue.
shots.scene: Sunny laundry nook beside a low wicker basket, smooth wooden floor, soft warm 3D lighting, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi peers beneath the basket through a toy magnifying glass.
shots.mood: Careful concentration, twitching whiskers, cosy golden light.

shots.narration: [excited] A yellow sock pointed straight toward the hallway!
shots.scene: Laundry doorway opening onto a colourful hallway, yellow sock on the floor, rounded 3D shapes, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi points at the yellow sock.
shots.mood: Wide green eyes, delighted discovery, sunny yellow accents.

shots.narration: More socks made a trail to Bruno's bed.
shots.scene: Cosy hallway with three scattered colourful socks leading toward a round puppy bed, warm 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi walks alongside the sock trail.
shots.mood: Quiet curiosity, careful little steps, inviting warm colours.

shots.narration: Bruno looked unusually busy with his blanket.
shots.scene: Sunny sitting-room corner, round puppy bed with a bulging blanket, Mishi beside the bed, rounded 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno pulls his blanket over a protruding striped sock.
shots.mood: Sheepish puppy smile, curious kitten gaze, gentle comic tension.

shots.narration: [surprised] Underneath lay a whole rainbow of missing socks!
shots.scene: Round puppy bed filled with colourful socks beneath a loose blanket, cosy 3D sitting room, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi lifts the blanket's corner to reveal the socks.
shots.mood: Mishi's wide eyes, Bruno's lowered floppy ears, bright rainbow fabric.

shots.narration: Bruno had borrowed them for a soft, snuggly nest.
shots.scene: Sock-filled puppy bed in a sunny sitting-room corner, Mishi seated nearby, soft rounded 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno rests his cheek on the pile of socks.
shots.mood: Sleepy puppy eyes, understanding kitten expression, soft cosy textures.

shots.narration: Mishi found something cosy that Bruno could keep.
shots.scene: Beside the round puppy bed, plain plump cushion between the friends, warm colourful 3D interior, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.mood: Kind kitten smile, hopeful puppy eyes, comforting pastel fabric.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno returned his borrowed bedtime collection.
shots.scene: Sitting-room floor beside a wicker laundry basket and puppy bed, warm 3D family animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno tips an armful of colourful socks into the basket.
shots.mood: Apologetic puppy smile, approving kitten expression, playful tumbling colours.

shots.narration: Soon, every sock had its partner again.
shots.scene: Low laundry table with neatly matched sock pairs and one separated striped pair, sunny 3D interior, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi places the final striped sock beside its match.
shots.mood: Satisfied green eyes, tidy rainbow rows, peaceful warm light.

shots.narration: And Bruno's own cushion made the perfect nest.
shots.scene: Round puppy bed with its plump cushion, Mishi sitting beside it, open garden doorway nearby, rounded 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.mood: Contented puppy smile, affectionate kitten gaze, soft golden sunshine.

shots.narration: [excited] Ask before borrowing; next comes the mystery of the rolling ball!
shots.scene: Sunny garden doorway beside Bruno's bed, both friends facing a bright red ball, cosy 3D family animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: A red ball rolls through the doorway toward the friends.
shots.mood: Perked ears, curious wide eyes, cheerful sunlight spilling across the floor.

episode.endHook: Next comes the mystery of the rolling ball!
episode.description: Where have all the socks gone? Detective Mishi follows a colourful trail to Bruno’s cosy bed, where the best friends discover why asking before borrowing matters.
